purpose: Differential check of the FIFO-unit-job Transfer Schedulability reduction and CRSI continuation elimination, not a hardware or upstream-runtime benchmark
selection: Exhaustive declared finite domains, fixed before first campaign execution; no fitted parameters and no favorable-outcome selection

uniprocessor.calendar: Every binary owner/idle calendar of period two, both phases
uniprocessor.plans: Every owner/idle word of the selected horizon
uniprocessor.backlog: 0 through horizon, retaining plans with service count <= backlog
uniprocessor.capacity_construction: Q_i=max(1,q_i+lead_i)+h, h in headroom. The headroom field is an increment above the minimum valid capacity; empty backlog and lead therefore give capacities 1 and 2, not 0 and 1.

multiprocessor.calendar: Every legal constant column; each also paired with a deterministic next column to test nonconstant calendars
multiprocessor.state_construction: Specified deterministically in transfer_campaign.py; initial backlog >= committed work, nonzero leads and monitor phases included

oracles: independently coded explicit unit-job TS critical-interval condition on every legal full per-tenant arrival path
negative_and_conservative_controls: saturated calendar domination (NOT the TS method)
output: Every case retained as JSON Lines with full snapshot, plan and decisions; aggregates kept separately
old_campaign: 66,858 retained instances are separate and not relabeled or added to these counts
